item.title: Toward practical all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries: from reaction mechanisms to engineering strategies
item.description:
Authors: Jinghua Wu, Tianyi Liu, Wenjie Wang, Hongli Wan, Xiayin Yao

This review presents a comprehensive framework for practical all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries by correlating sulfur reaction mechanisms, interfacial challenges, and engineering strategies toward high-performance and practical applications.

item.title: Harnessing crown ethers in separation membranes toward energy and environmental sustainability
item.description:
Authors: Yuanyuan Guo, Huan Yu, Heng Dong, Yanan Guo, Gongping Liu, Wanqin Jin

This review connects crown ether supramolecular chemistry with membrane engineering and rationalizes the interplay between microstructural configurations and macroscopic separation efficacy across diverse material platforms.

item.title: Interfacial adhesive materials and chemistry in extreme/complex environments
item.description:
Authors: Xizi Wan, Jingwei Lu, Feilong Zhang, Jingxin Meng, Ye Tian, Yong Chen, Shao-Fei Zheng, Yongyang Song, Xiao-Dong Wang, Shutao Wang

An overview of interfacial adhesive materials tailored for high temperature, low temperature, high salinity, and physiological environments.

item.title: Understanding and controlling crystal water in Prussian blue analogues
item.description:
Authors: Yun Gao, Hang Zhang, Xihao Lin, Yangyang Liu, Xingqiao Wu, Xiaohao Liu, Yu Su, Huanhuan Dong, Rui Wang, Chaofeng Zhang, Shulei Chou, Li Li

Prussian blue analogues suffer from lattice-water-induced capacity decay and safety concerns. This review elucidates water–electrochemistry interactions, summarizes removal and blocking strategies, and discusses scale-up challenges.

item.title: Carbon–carbon bond cleavage for lignin and plastics deconstruction
item.description:

item.description:
Authors: Qianru Chen, Wei Wang, Zhihao Tian, Junnan Hao, Shi-Zhang Qiao

This review critically assesses inorganic aqueous redox flow batteries beyond vanadium, with a focus on key challenges, mitigation strategies, and their readiness for grid-scale energy storage.

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Fluoroalkyl carbenes: versatile platforms for fluoroalkylated functional molecules
